title: 10^5 condition replacements racing the scan never stop, stall or fault the task
notes: Covers the normal build's run. Not expressed: the TSan build's race report and the source inspection of the read-side enter (a build variant and a code read, not steps); clear-all of 1,024 breakpoints and the arm past the limit (loop-bodies has far fewer breakpoint-able lines; ~lines would be BLOCKED); condition-error events (no event name for them is fixed). A stop during the churn shows as a scan gap.
